src: The person who has the key, and the individuals who will lie about everything they say, will change every time you guess incorrectly.
Don't muck it up, okay?
Hey you!
This here is your final challenge.
To continue, you'll need a key.
One of the guards behind me has it. Try to find out who.
It might be Drun over there.
Hi.
It could also be Cluvo.
Hello.
Or one of the others.
Oh the poor failures. Poor failures.
Who did this to them? Who?
Why did it have to die? Why?
What failures?
They came in from upstairs. From upstairs.
Where the Hierarch rests. The Hierarch.
And we took them in. Took them in.
But I worry. I worry.
Are they well? Well?
You mean that cyborg, that's in pain?
Oh no, he's in pain? He's in pain?
We should help him. Should help him.
No.
What a pity you think that way. What a pity.
May the Hierarch forgive you. Forgive you.
You can still change your mind. Change your mind.
Of course.
Good. Good.
I think I know a way. Know a way.
But we need to gather some things for this. Some things for this.
We need some glibber, a brain and some flesh. And some flesh.
I am sure you will find everything you need on this floor. On this floor.
You mean those in the small room?
You know them? Know them?
I talked with one of them.
He's in pain.
That's not good. Not good.
We need to help. Need to help.
Did you give him the pain reliever yet? Give him the pain reliever?
Please hurry. Hurry.
We need the ingredients for a pain reliever. Pain reliever.
Please hurry. Hurry.
You are back. Back.
Do you have everything we need? Everything we need?
Not yet.
Then please, hurry and get it. Hurry.
Yes.
Good. Good.
It's done. Done.
Please give this to the cyborg. The cyborg.
He will feel better. Feel better.
[Give weird meat.]
[Give normal meat.]
It did not help. Not help.
Why? Why?
Was one of the ingredients wrong? Ingredients wrong?
You did well to help the failures. The failures.
The Hierarch will be very grateful. Very grateful.
Please don't interrupt us. Interrupt us.
We are analyzing this robot. This robot.
I'm looking for pain reliever ingredients.
I don't care. Don't care.
I'm working. Working.
Whatever. Whatever.
Will you shut up, if I give you this? Will you?
How about this? How about this?
We pull the shell from both sides. From both sides.
We will expose the sensors much more easily. Much more easily.
We already tried that. Tried that.
But we need some much heavier machinery for this. For this.
I have an idea. An idea.
What is it? What?
We take its levitation module. Levitation module.
And attach it to a human torso. Human torso.
We can make people without legs fly. People without legs fly.
Did you already forget what happened last time we tried that? Last time we tried that?
Do you think you could get me the thermal unwelder? Thermal unwelder?
Sure. Sure.
Here. Here.
Thank you. Thank you.
Look at this. Look.
Truly intricate. Intricate.
Interesting. Interesting.
So many parts. So many.
Do you see this? See this?
A levitating robot.
The hatch on its back is open, revealing all the wiring and mechanics inside.
*bzzzzt
I should probably keep my distance from it.
Let's see. Lets see.
*bzzzzt
Ouch! Ouch!
I do work for the Hierarch. The Hierarch.
We will improve his army. His army.
The Hierarch is great. Is great.
It is an honour to meet him. To meet him.
Sometimes i wonder. I wonder.
How did I get here? Get here?
The Hierarch is kind. Is kind.
He gave us this place to sleep. Sleep.
Do you have ingredients for a pain reliever?
I'm sorry. Sorry.
I don't have anything. Have anything.
Pain reliever? Pain reliever?
Who is in pain? Who is?
That cyborg failure in the small room.
Yes. Yes.
I want to help. Help.
But I only have glibber. Only glibber.
That would help a lot, actually.
Then take it. Take it.
Where's the key?
Nothing.
Recruit!
You have now reached the place, where the strong ones reside.
This is the place for survivors.
This is where we plan how to defeat the Machine God.
This is the place for the strong and the smart.
And you belong here too, now.
Welcome to the Mechanical Body Parts Remover Unit.
How can this unit be of service?
What does this unit do, exactly?
This unit will help with removing mechanical body parts.
Beginning examination...
No mechanical body parts detected.
Mechanical weapon part detected.
Do you want to remove the mechanical part?
No, don't remove it.
Yes, please remove this weapon.
Beginning procedure...
You look strong. Very strong.
Will you help me? Help?
It's urgent. Urgent.
Give it up.
Your friend wont return anymore.
Liar! Liar!
I know she is still in there. In there.
Waiting for somebody to rescue her. Rescue her.
How are you doing?
Great. Great.
And since I'm not alone anymore, time passes faster. Pass faster.
But, could you go in the tower for me? For me?
My friend is still in there. Still there.
And I'm worried. Worried.
Why are you talking like this?
What do you mean? You mean?
Always repeating words. Again and again.
I am talking normally. Normally.
But enough about me. About me.
I need help. Help me.
I am already helping.
You look strong. Very strong.
Please help. Help me.
Hey you! You!
So, what will you do now?
Take care of my friend, of course.
You have helped me a lot.
Thanks to you, I could see Noor again.
Even if she is a bit ... different.
I found your friend.
But she's a bit different than you might remember her.
Hey you! You!
You look strong. Very strong.
Will you help me? Help?
It's urgent. Urgent.
Friend.
You look strong. Very strong.
Will you help me? Help?
It's urgent. Urgent.
The fuck is going on here?
I'm looking for someone to save my friend. My friend.
Yeah, you already said that before.
No, I didn't. I didn't.
Yes, you did.
Are you calling me crazy? Me crazy?
No.
I am not crazy. Not crazy.
Let me proove it to you.
Yes.
You're repeating yourself.
You look strong. Very strong.
Yeah, you already said that before.
Will you help me? Help?
I already did.
She is right here.
She is my friend? Friend?
Friend.
Oh, how wonderful. Wonderful.
You see my friend has gone into this tower. Tower.
And she hasn't come out yet. Not yet.
Will you go in and get her for me? For me?
I Friend. Stay together.
You want to stay with me? Stay with me?
Yes. Stay together. Friend.
Then we can wait here for my friend together. Together.
And when somebody strong comes, we can send them in to look for her. Look for her.
Friend.
Calm down.
Your friend is right here.
My friend... is here? Where?
Are you blind?
She's literally standing just next to you.
This can't be my friend. Friend.
My friend is very beautiful. Beautiful.
She is in the tower, waiting. Waiting.
You could at least talk to her.
Ok. Ok.
So, who are you? Are you?
No, that's really your friend.
Are you really telling the truth? The truth?
If this is really her, she must be hurting. Hurting.
We must release her from the pain. From the pain.
Yes, look.
This person is my friend? Friend?
Yes.
I don't understand. Understand.
Please trust me.
She clearly recognizes you.
I don't know her. Don't know.
If you're not here to help, just leave. Just leave.
Same goes for you. For you.
But friend?
Just go away. Away.
The two of you came here together.
I don't really understand why, but somehow you ended up out here, telling people to climb the tower.
This doesn't make sense. No sense.
I am waiting for my friend. My friend.
She is in the tower. The tower.
I know it. I know.
If you don't want to believe me, maybe you'd at least want to befriend this cyborg here?
She will be my friend? Friend?
No. We good friends before.
This is for the best of you both.
Just take good care of each other, will you?
You were brainwashed by the Titan.
Brainwashed? Brainwashed?
Yes. He does that to people.
They all talk in circles. Like you.
It would also explain, why you don't recognize her.
I don't understand. Don't understand.
It makes my head hurt. My head hurts.
Relax. This doesn't look healthy.
Just know that this woman here wants to be friends with you.
Stay strong. You need to remember.
She's your friend.
We friends. Came together.
This hurts. It hurts.
It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It huuuurts.
Aaaarrrrgh.
Oh my goodness.
Are you Noor?
We wanted to go to the tower.
What the fuck happened to you?
Come here. Let me take care of you.
Remember. You two climbed the tower together.
There's a Titan there, who turned her into this.
And he sent you out, to lure in more people for him.
I'm luring people? Luring?
This... hurts. My head hurts.
Your friend is dead.
You're silly. Silly.
She is inside the tower. Waiting. Waiting.
Why are you talking like this.
You already asked this. Asked this.
Why are you repeating yourself?
I don't understand. Understand.
I just need help. Help.
What's the matter?
My friend has gone into this tower here. Tower.
And she hasn't come back yet. Not back.
It's been several days now. Days.
I don't think she's alive anymore.
What do you mean? Do you mean?
I'll just wait for her. Wait for her.
What is stopping you?
I cannot tell. Cannot.
Please go inside. Go.
Please help me. Help.
Can't you look for her yourself?
What an odd idea. Odd.
I cannot. Cannot.
It is stopping me. Stopping.
Will you help me? Help?
Sure, I'll go and check.
Thank you. You.
I don't think she's in there anymore.
Has a woman come by recently?
Many have approached since I started spreading the word.
The person you mean might, or might not, have survived this place.
If you wish to check, come to the top.
Who are you?
I am the one who has seen the danger.
I am the one who opposes the machines.
I am the one who stands on top of the tower.
Reach me, and all will be answered.
What's going on here?
So the subject does not even know why it is here.
Worry not.
If you wish to turn stronger.
